Description: Runs the output prep steps checked for All prints in Dyl-Settings, then the native PUBLISH dialog.

Name: Quick Save
Description: Runs the output prep steps checked for All saves in Dyl-Settings, then the native QSAVE.

Name: Save As
Description: Runs the output prep steps checked for All saves in Dyl-Settings, then the native SAVEAS dialog.

Description: Runs the output prep steps checked for All prints in Dyl-Settings, then the native EXPORTPDF dialog.

Name: Export DWF
Description: Runs the output prep steps checked for All prints in Dyl-Settings, then the native EXPORTDWF dialog.

Description: Runs the output prep steps checked for All prints in Dyl-Settings, then the native EXPORTDWFX dialog.

Name: Set Units

Name: Standard Grid

Description: Looks for other programs that redefine the DynALisp commands, aliases or startup, and their reactors.

Name: Diagnostics Startup Suite
Description: Checks the Startup Suite and the aliases: missing files, commands not defined, aliases without a command.

Name: Diagnostics Settings

Name: Diagnostics Drawing

Name: Text Prefix Suffix

Name: Batch Insert

Name: Dictionary

Name: Group Cluster

Description: Toggles the (OB) suffix on the text of the selected dimension.

Description: Toggles the (OL) suffix on the text of the selected dimension.

Name: Quick Select Similar

Name: Rebuild Patterns

Name: Open Patterns Folder

Description: Reports the layer structure of every drawing in a folder and its subfolders.
